# AptLayer

> Independent AI product engineering studio in Kraków, Poland. AptLayer builds production AI features, MCP servers, agentic workflows and agent-ready products for software companies and operational teams.

Primary language: English. Polish version: https://aptlayer.github.io/pl/
Contact: gwizdala.kr@gmail.com

## Services

- AI feature implementation for existing SaaS and software products
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server design and implementation
- Agent-ready product engineering and discoverability
- Agentic workflow architecture, orchestration and human approval
- LLM evaluation, model routing, caching and cost optimization
- AI product, architecture and agent-readiness audits
- AI-native applications built from zero
- Agentic engineering workflow design for software teams

## Selected work

- Agent Rynku: production AI equity analyst for Warsaw Stock Exchange filings, with one MCP data layer serving in-product chat, Telegram and user-connected clients. https://agentrynku.pl/
- Let Agents In: deterministic agent-readiness audits measuring discovery, registration, credential provisioning and integration. https://letagentsin.com/
- Meet Live Assist: local-first meeting assistant delivered as a Chrome extension and local MCP server. https://meet-live-assist.github.io/
- Open-source MCP portfolio: payment gateways, governed content editing, voice, developer integration and agent payments. https://github.com/krystiangw

## Studio

AptLayer is founder-led by Krystian Gwizdała, an AI engineer and full-stack product developer with more than ten years of experience. Engineering portfolio: https://krystian-gwizdala.github.io/

## Engagement model

Direct access to the senior engineer designing and building the system. Work typically starts with a focused audit or sprint, continues through a production implementation and can extend into measurement and optimization.
